quotations.old_english: Bleówun windas and ahruron on ðæt hús
quotations.latin: flaverunt venti et irruerunt in domum illam

quotations.old_english: On Godes naman ahreóse ðís tempel
quotations.english: in God's name let this temple fall down

source_text: a-hreósan; p. -hreás, pl. -hruron; pp. -hroren [a, hreósan to rush] To rush, fall, fall down; irruere, mere, corruere, decidere :-- Bleówun windas and ahruron on ðæt hús flaverunt venti et irruerunt in domum illam, Mt. Bos. 7, 25. On Godes naman ahreóse ðís tempel in God's name let this temple fall down. Homl. Th. i. 72, 2, 5. He ahreás he fell, Homl. Th. i. 192, 20.
